name: OCaml
reason: The complete pinned OCaml row includes .eliom and .eliomi. Its exact controller assigns these to implementation and interface grammar scopes. The complete example.eliom uses the three tier-specific curly section forms and a double-braced client expression, independently tied to Eliom by the 2014 Ocsigen author slides. The current Eliom PPX guide illustrates percent/extension-node syntax for the same project contexts. The row also includes .mll and .mly, for which the controller supplies separate OCamllex and Menhir modes. The pinned row groups these extension and tool surfaces with ordinary OCaml source. That supports the scoped language association and leaves whole-row equivalence unresolved.
